title: White House Reportedly Shares Purportedly AI-Altered Arrest Photo Depicting Minnesota Protester Nekima Levy Armstrong as Crying

behaviors.text: The White House reportedly posted a purportedly AI-altered image on X showing Minnesota protester and attorney a person appearing to cry during her arrest.
Reported analysis by third parties using AI detection tools found signs of purported facial manipulation, which could be replicated using generative AI systems.
